Our Story

Two electricians, one mission.

Matt & Tim built HomeownerPal because they'd seen too many people taken advantage of when they needed help the most.

Matthew and Timothy have worked in the electrical and service industries for most of their lives, with over two decades of combined experience specifically in the electrical field. Over the years, they have successfully completed thousands of jobs, written thousands of estimates, and built lasting relationships with both homeowners and contractors along the way.

"Like many people, they have faced struggles in their pasts. Since becoming friends, they have worked tirelessly to become better versions of themselves each day, not only as electricians, but also as fathers, friends, and people."

Throughout their years in the trades, one thing became impossible to ignore: far too many contractors, not just in the electrical industry, take advantage of people when they are at their most stressed, overwhelmed, or desperate for help.

That is the reason HomeownerPal exists.

Matt & Tim

Our goal is to help educate and assist homeowners nationwide so they can make more informed decisions and avoid being taken advantage of when they need help the most.

Every pro we recommend is ranked the same honest way, real reviews, never a paid placement. See exactly how on Find a Pro or browse real reviews in the Contractor Forum.

Today, Matthew and Timothy are like brothers, and HomeownerPal represents something deeply personal to both of them: continuing to grow, continuing to improve, and doing everything possible to genuinely help people.

The HOPline will always be free to call if you need advice or guidance.

Thank you for supporting us, and God bless.

— Matt & Tim

Important, please read

HomeownerPal (HOP) is built and maintained by people with decades of combined hands-on trade experience. The guidance here is grounded in real field experience and is intended to help homeowners understand what's likely happening, what a fair price range looks like, and what questions to ask. That said, home systems are complex and every situation is different. Some issues simply require a qualified technician on-site to physically test, locate, and confirm the actual cause before any repair should be made.

Electricity, gas, and water systems can cause serious injury or death. If you smell burning, see smoke or sparks, hear sustained buzzing, or otherwise suspect an emergency, stop, leave the area, and call 911 and/or a licensed professional immediately. Do not attempt repairs you are not trained or permitted to perform; many jurisdictions legally require licensed and inspected work.

Price ranges shown are rough estimates only and vary by region, code requirements, and site conditions. See our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Install the HOP app

HOP works great as an app on your phone — quick to open the next time something goes sideways at home. It only takes a few taps.

On iPhone / iPad (Safari)

  1. Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
  2. Scroll and tap Add to Home Screen.
  3. Tap Add in the top corner. Done — HOP is on your home screen.

On Android (Chrome)

  1. Tap the menu in the top-right of Chrome.
  2. Tap Add to Home screen (or Install app).
  3. Confirm with Add / Install. Look for the bunny on your home screen.

HOP is always free, and the app is just our website saved to your home screen — no app store needed.
